product_metadata.title: MR&HM Satin Bed Sheets, King Size Sheets Set, 4 Pcs Silky Bedding Set with 15 Inches Deep Pocket for Mattress(King, Black Striped)
features: 【King Size Sheets Set 4 Pcs】 Our package includes 1 Flat Sheet: 108"x 102", 1 Fitted Sheet: 78"x 80" + 15" Deep Pocket, 2 Pillowcases: 20"x 40".

【Goodbye To Messy Morning Hair】 With our 600 thread count satin bed sheets, you can rest easy knowing your hair will be soft & smooth when you wake up. The satin fabric allows your hair to remain frizz and tangle-free and reduces hair breakage. MR&HM king sheets provide a brand new sleeping experience.

【Enhance Your Beauty Sleep】 Sleeping on our satin sheets feel silky and soothe the skin. In addition, the satin sheets reduce the friction to your body. The less friction, the fewer the sleep lines during sleep, reducing the appearance of wrinkles in the long term.

【Affordable Luxury】 Compared with silk sheets, satin fabric is more durable. Silk fabric is easy to draw and pilling, and our satin fabric uses a higher count to significantly reduce the possibility of pilling. The silky fibers are great for temperature regulation, breathable, and not stuffy. MR&HM satin sheets are high quality and extravagant, which are luxury at an affordable price.

【Easy Care】Taking the proper garment care of your pillowcase and sheets is essential if you like to preserve their durability. Machine washable, gentle cycle in cold water and dry on low heat. Do not bleach.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine Wash, Do_not_bleach, Hand Wash Only
